U-PATTERN-LISTING-DISCOVERY-RAIL.responsive_behavior: Desktop rail may reveal date context only while source-pinned; mobile retains controls without inventing a separate route composition.

U-PATTERN-CONTENT-SHELF.responsive_behavior: Shelf heading and content plane remain together; count/category inventory wraps without changing semantic order.

U-PATTERN-LISTING-SECTION-HEADER.responsive_behavior: Header navigation wraps while title/count identity remains stable across listing surfaces.

U-PATTERN-AUTHORIZED-SEARCH-BAR.responsive_behavior: Standalone textarea and embedded search input share the same authenticated lifecycle without merging result content into the bar.

U-PATTERN-LISTING-FILTER-BAR.responsive_behavior: Filter chips remain source-owned controls; row reflow and result counts are downstream consumers.

U-PATTERN-CONTENT-GROUPING.responsive_behavior: Grouping keeps heading and items in one semantic section; mobile changes columns, not group identity.
